scope: Explicit percentage units for YoY selection and chart values

finding.before: Headers containing YoY with percentage points, money or basis points admitted scalars into a percent chart.
finding.after: Full header match plus explicit percent unit in header or cell; ambiguous bare scalars and incompatible headers rejected.

validation.real_cli: Percentage-point table retained, YoY chart omitted, ordinary financial chart retained; source bytes unchanged.

limits: Financial units, multi-column YoY selection, full geometry and actual PDF/visual acceptance remain unverified.
No implicit ratio-to-percent or unit conversion.
No app, commit, push or release.
